transcript.text: Last year I was bouncing around Beijing a lot, and I remember casually browsing restaurants there just to kill time.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: One night I ended up at this place called Imperial Kitchen—pretty sure that’s the name that popped up everywhere back then.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Funny thing is my friend Zhang Wei had already booked it for 2025-03-16 at 19:00, so I didn’t do anything except show up.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: It was just me at the table—party size 1—and he used 13871016229 on the reservation, which I only noticed because the SMS was on his phone.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Around that same time in Beijing I was also comparing home service options people talk about, plus I’d been reading random stuff on medicine and books—kind of a messy phase.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My cousin Chen Ming was the organized one—he’d already enrolled in Data Structures and Algorithms, and he even had a home service booked for 2025-03-23 at 14:00 to Room 295, Building A, East District, using 13833841705.
